response.sql: SELECT p.SEX, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(l.DNA), '') AS REAL)) AS average_anti_dna, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS average_albumin_minus_total_protein FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l."T-CHO" >= 180 GROUP BY p.SEX

assumptions.assumption: Nonblank DNA values are numeric text; blank DNA values are missing. The schema does not specify how to interpret other nonnumeric DNA text.
